text:
**My pick for a slim iPhone 17 power bank: Anker Nano Power Bank (5K, MagGo, Slim).** I couldn't verify its exact specs. If you'd rather have more capacity and faster charging, get the Baseus PicoGo AM52.

**Best slim: Anker Nano Power Bank (5,000 mAh, 15W Qi2), about $54.99**
- 9to5Mac's June 2026 roundup calls it the closest alternative to Apple's own MagSafe battery. It's very thin and feels premium.
- Buy: https://www.anker.com/products/a1665-5k-ultra-slim-qi2-power-bank
- The Anker page failed to load when I tried it. The price and specs come from 9to5Mac, not from Anker. Check the page for the current price and any recall notice before you buy.

**Best if you'll trade some slimness for speed: Baseus PicoGo AM52 (10,000 mAh, Qi2.2)**
- It charges an iPhone 17 wirelessly at up to 25W on iOS 26. It also has 45W USB-C output, so it can charge other devices.
- It's a Qi2.2-certified bank and is approved for airline carry-on.
- It costs $59.99, or about $53.99 with code **AM52**. The deal page says the code worked in Baseus's cart on Oct 24, but checkout decides whether it applies. That page is a deal-tracking site, so I haven't confirmed the code with Baseus.
- Buy: https://dealectric.com/go/baseus-picogo-am52-qi2-2-10000mah-45w. This link goes through the deal site to Baseus's US store.
- Its thickness and weight weren't listed, so it will be thicker than the Anker.

**Other options**
- **UGREEN 10,000 mAh (Qi2.2, 25W), $59.99:** 9to5Mac says it's thicker than the Anker. I didn't find a link for it.
- **Baseus 5,000 mAh, $24.99:** It's thin and cheap, but it only charges at 7.5W and has no Qi2. I'd skip it for an iPhone 17.
- **Belkin 25W, $99.99:** 9to5Mac calls it chunky. It has a kickstand and a display.
- **LISEN P601 (5,000 mAh, 15W Qi2):** The listing says 0.38 in and about 102–106 g, but its own figures conflict. It's a wholesale page with no consumer price, so I wouldn't count on it.

I couldn't open the Android Central review of 2026 slim Qi2 banks, so I haven't used it. I also didn't read the Macworld or Wired roundups.

Choose the Anker if you want a battery that stays slim on the back of your phone. Choose the Baseus if you want faster charging and about twice the capacity.
